inventoryMeaning: Mechanical source coverage plus behavior catalog. Pending entries are not ported; implementation is not live verification.

features.behavior: Schema v2, old enum fallbacks, consent flags, optional key/VPN paths, invalid date handling
features.acceptance: Schema/consent, old fallbacks and invalid dates have native fixtures; compile and verify original imports/restart under R12.

features.behavior: Atomic save/recovery, corrupt-file preservation, create/edit/duplicate/rename/import/export
features.acceptance: Atomic native save, missing-primary backup recovery, corrupt-primary preservation and non-clobber import/export have disk fixtures. Runtime/restart checks remain R12.

features.behavior: Favorites, search, delete, trash/restore, delete associated credentials
features.acceptance: Bookmark, trash/restore, purge and associated native credential removal; verify saved-state and failure handling.

features.behavior: Solid dark bronze/black and light cream/gold themes, native controls, selected icon contrast and product icon
features.acceptance: Background images and texture loading removed at user request. Verify native controls, selection contrast, resizing and DPI in both modes under R12.

features.behavior: Resizable sidebar, reset width, assistant/log panels preserve active connection
features.acceptance: Persistent resize/reset and original sidebar shortcut implemented. Native state fixtures preserve workspace; pointer/narrow-layout and restart checks remain R12.

features.behavior: Independent duplicate connections, reorder, relative keyboard navigation, close/reconnect
features.acceptance: R10 adds stable tab identities, virtual scrolling/reveal, drag reorder, wrapped keyboard navigation and close-all. Native state/shortcut/application tests preserve identities; compiler/live focus and cleanup checks remain R12.

features.behavior: Connection status, errors, notifications and system status counters
features.acceptance: R10 adds bounded five-second notices with fade/dismiss/log mirror, active Connections actions, counts and clock. Queue/lifetime/overflow fixtures added; compiler/live checks remain R12.

features.behavior: Real SSH, password, encrypted private key, Ed25519/RSA-SHA2, timeout, keepalive, TCP_NODELAY
features.acceptance: Run Windows tests and live password/key/passphrase sessions; no weak crypto fallback.

features.behavior: Unknown-host fingerprint prompt, known_hosts verification, reject changed key/read errors
features.acceptance: Confirmation is bound to host/port/fingerprint; changed key on retry is refused.

features.behavior: Cancel connecting, disconnect, reconnect, close all, bounded input/output, host process cleanup
features.acceptance: R1: gated reconnect until worker cleanup, explicit channel EOF/close, X11 startup cleanup and owned AI/Tools SSH process groups with renewable leases. Ten interpreted cleanup fixtures pass in the cached AlmaLinux/Bash 4.4 build environment, including heartbeat read-boundary and malformed-input checks; compiler and live auth/transfer/process-leak checks remain.

features.behavior: Separate interactive/graphics channels and shared cancellation
features.acceptance: SSH+X11/desktop use production separate bulk transport; verify interactive latency during graphics/file transfers.

features.behavior: Process-local WireGuard TCP/DNS, IPv4/IPv6, no OS route mutation
features.acceptance: Live WireGuard SSH/SFTP; malformed configuration and cancellation.

features.behavior: Streaming UTF-8, VT/ANSI, 256/true colour, alternate screen, resize, cursor, scrollback
features.acceptance: R2 adds mouse protocols/motion/wheel, IME commit deduplication, AltGr and saved screen geometry/settings. Compare vim/top, split Unicode, wide cells and focus release live.

features.behavior: Readline Ctrl/Alt shortcuts, Ctrl+Shift+A selection, clipboard combinations
features.acceptance: Readline keys, local clipboard/selection and Shift scrollback coexist with AltGr/IME; run focused native key and live shell regressions.

features.behavior: Mouse selection, right click copy-or-paste, bracketed paste
features.acceptance: Remote OSC clipboard requests cannot read local clipboard; no duplicate paste.

features.behavior: Persisted font/scrollback settings, semantic output colours, presets, colour-blind theme
features.acceptance: Four original presets, eleven semantic roles and saved font/geometry/history/classification choices added. Explicit ANSI colours retain precedence; compare original fixtures and restart settings live.

features.behavior: OSC7 prompt integration, file pane follows shell, quoted path insertion
features.acceptance: Bash prompt OSC7 follows shell directories; explicit file-pane navigation quotes a user-initiated cd. Split reports and invalid paths have source regressions. Other shells may supply OSC7; escape output never executes commands.

features.behavior: Dual local/server panes, editable address bars, sorted navigation, current directory
features.acceptance: Dual editable paths and canonical directory listings reject stale replies. Check typing, navigation, selected rows and narrow layouts live.

features.behavior: Drag/drop, recursive transfers, queue, resume, cancellation, parallel transfers, progress
features.acceptance: R4 adds a durable four-job queue, bounded recursive plans, OS/pane drops, pause/retry/resume and explicit stage cleanup. Original hashes/host-account-key bindings survive restart; validate real SFTP prefix/conflict fixtures and live reconnect/cancellation.

features.behavior: Context menus, rename, delete, mkdir, properties, Unix chmod, copy path/path-to-terminal
features.acceptance: Local/server menus, Windows properties/security, Unix chmod, no-clobber rename, open-document ancestor protection and quoted path insertion added. Compare read-only file snapshots; run OS/menu/root/link regressions.

features.behavior: Classify text/binary, remote working copies, use associated LOCAL application, Open With
features.acceptance: Windows associations and Open With run off the UI thread; host-bound working copies/drafts survive restart, external changes are detected and explicit uploads preserve newer external edits. Test KLayout, picker cancellation, reopen/recovery and server conflicts.

features.behavior: 8 MiB text limit, UTF-8/UTF-16 BOM, CRLF, control-character rejection, safe Windows names
features.acceptance: Native editor consumes UTF-8/UTF-16/BOM model and preserves bytes/line endings; run round-trip fixtures.

features.behavior: Revision/canonical-host checks, atomic staged saves, permissions/ownership preservation
features.acceptance: Native consumers use original SFTP revisions/staged save and local conflict checks; verify races, permissions, disconnected/changed host and recovery.

features.behavior: Separate native editor window; lifetime independent of parent; no duplicate close control
features.acceptance: Independent native viewports with Save/Discard/Cancel and parent shutdown deferral; repeated open/close and crash/freeze regression not run.

features.behavior: Tabs, languages, syntax, indentation, search/replace, undo/redo, diff, saved working copy
features.acceptance: R5 source implemented: document/window switching, language selection and embedded syntax colouring, line numbers/wrap/font controls, tabs/spaces and auto indentation, case/word/regex/selected-range search with capture replacement, undo/redo, goto line and aligned saved/file comparisons. Compile and run keyboard, encoding and large-file regressions in R12.

features.behavior: Language server lifecycle, diagnostics, completion, hover, remote/local language services
features.acceptance: R5 source implements local and original-host SSH language services, per-language/host saved explicit server configuration, completion with additional edits, hover/diagnostics, definition navigation and reviewed formatting/multi-file rename. UTF-16, version, overlap, file-size and dirty-target validation precede buffer edits. Windows child cleanup and live server validation remain R12. Resource creation/deletion/rename and snippets are not advertised.

features.behavior: Provision Linux agent, authenticate control/data channels, session IDs, fallback transport
features.acceptance: Native lifecycle uses checksummed bundled agent/runtime and production retained-session handshake; live host validation remains.

features.behavior: Aether custom stream/control protocol, QUIC/SSH transport, QoS, H264 decode/render
features.acceptance: Original stream/demux/decoder/framebuffer pipeline is used directly; verify colour/stride/frame order and performance.

features.behavior: Physical key scan codes, lock state, mouse/wheel, release keys on focus loss
features.acceptance: R6 source preserves physical Windows keypad/sided modifiers/AltGr/Win/menu/Print/Pause, lock flags, repeat, native mouse order and focus/lease release; exact foreground routing excludes injected events and toolbar/other windows. Existing IME path retains agent capability limits. Compile source regressions and verify live keyboard/drag/system shortcuts under R12.

features.behavior: Embedded/fullscreen/current/all monitors, DPI, host resize, reposition off-screen windows
features.acceptance: R6 source uses native physical monitor geometry and window placement, mixed DPI/negative origins, full host layouts on every tab/current/all transition, even/protocol-bounded sizes and unplugged-device fallback. Compile and verify host window repositioning, pointer alignment and hotplug under R12.

features.behavior: User-draggable edge-docked auto-hiding toolbar, restore-to-tab, all/current monitor
features.acceptance: R6 source adds free/edge dragging, auto-hide, monitor-aware scaling and persisted validated ratios/device with corrupt-file preservation. Compile regressions and verify all four edges, reconnect/restart, resizing/DPI and removed-monitor fallback under R12.

features.behavior: Bidirectional clipboard, remote frame capture, fullscreen screenshots
features.acceptance: Production clipboard bridge, focus-scoped local polling and actual frame capture wired; live loop/encoding/clipboard checks remain.

features.behavior: Detach/retain/reconnect vs End remote session, ACK, successful disconnect and cleanup
features.acceptance: R1: cancellation owns bounded launch/partial handshake, rolls back positively identified fresh agents and preserves existing desktops; unclaimed launches expire. Duplicate IDs persist before launch and reopen through Saved desktop tabs; confirmed End removes records. Compile and validate live cancellation/restart/termination.

features.behavior: Supervisor, Smithay/Wayland/Xwayland, desktop launch, encoder, input, multi-monitor, icons
features.acceptance: Existing production Rust agent is retained and included by the native build recipe, which runs its integration tests when the user builds.

features.behavior: Bundled VcXsrv, private authority, per-tab cookies, loopback proxy, shared owned display, health/cleanup
features.acceptance: R9 adds serialized shared-server leases, per-tab forwarding cookies, last-tab shutdown, old-generation isolation, Windows cleanup jobs and private fallback-icon settings. The production icon helper, clipboard, software GLX and multiwindow mode remain. Stage 4 runs the real bundled-manager regression; compile/package/live verification remains R12.

features.behavior: Windows Credential Manager, original key namespaces, remember/delete, username consent
features.acceptance: Native Credential Manager store/forget and username consent implemented in a separate namespace. Existing production credential import/namespace compatibility remains.

features.behavior: DPAPI and master-password encryption, authentication failure, unlock/forget behavior
features.acceptance: Native DPAPI plus PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 master entropy, context binding and zeroization added. Original envelope compatibility and Windows runtime checks remain.

features.behavior: Secret masking in app/core/host/audit logs, bounded/rotated storage
features.acceptance: Production bounded asynchronous JSONL logging, rotation and redaction are retained. Native rotation/redaction/export fixtures added; live cross-process/export checks remain R12.

features.behavior: Connected service list, add/edit/remove key, custom endpoint, searchable alphabetical providers/models
features.acceptance: Original provider IDs/endpoints/manual models migrate; all model tiers stay searchable with declared capability metadata. Custom manual models survive renaming, refresh and restart; first-chat provider/workspace restore no longer silently falls back. Windows/provider verification remains.

features.behavior: HTTPS/loopback HTTP policy, redirect rejection, endpoint normalization, TLS, request-size limits
features.acceptance: HTTPS/loopback policy, no redirects, native TLS, endpoint normalization and bounded requests added; run provider fixtures/live checks.

features.behavior: SSE streaming, nullable frames, model IDs/output limits, multimodal messages, provider errors
features.acceptance: Bounded SSE and model-capped output limits; OpenRouter reasoning and optional NVIDIA NIM thinking parameters are capability/provider-specific. Live provider checks remain.

features.behavior: Three transient retries, Retry-After, 60s budget, 120s stream timeout, stop, quota errors
features.acceptance: Transient pre-response retries with budget, timeout and cancellation; run interruption/rate-limit fixtures and verify no action replay.

features.behavior: Native replacement of LangGraph turn loop, tool schemas/results, bounded actions and outputs
features.acceptance: Bounded native turn loop, correlated tool results and interrupted-history repair; compile and run native tests, then live tools.

features.behavior: Action/message/chat approvals, denial, revoke, no durable grants, cancel/stale-reply rejection
features.acceptance: Action/message/chat grants consumed by native UI and execution path; revoke on workspace/history changes and never serialize grants.

features.behavior: Windows-folder and SSH scopes, canonical path checks, revision checks, no local fallback
features.acceptance: Windows/SSH scope and revision checks, no local fallback, Windows jobs and R1 leased SSH process-group cleanup implemented. Verify canonical scopes, connection-loss cleanup and races live; deliberately daemonized services need their own stop.

features.behavior: Left sidebar chat preserves workspace, Enter send/Ctrl+Enter newline, draft/history/model state
features.acceptance: Per-chat provider/model, draft, local workspace, reasoning, tool and token-budget state restore; remote scope requires the matching live connection.

features.behavior: Chat persistence, individual delete/clear-all, reject delete while running, remove stored attachments
features.acceptance: Original transcripts import without executable tool actions; per-chat bounded files, metadata index, lazy restore, older-message reveal, delete/clear and interruption repair are implemented.

features.behavior: Attach/current connection capture, stable thumbnail bytes, preview/remove, image caps
features.acceptance: Stable capture thumbnail, preview/remove and approved app capture; 1600px/1MiB limits. Verify vision models and fullscreen capture.

features.behavior: List/select connections, open files/folders, show Tools/Logs, capture by connection identity
features.acceptance: Approved list/select connections, open files/folders, panels, terminal text and screen capture; actions use current identities without changing AI workspace.

features.behavior: Strict schema v1, size/ID/version/parameter validation, revision hashes, install/remove/list
features.acceptance: Strict validated schema/revision install/remove/list wired; executable script included in AI run approval; installation never runs it.

features.behavior: Windows PowerShell and SSH scripts, quoted parameter environment, previews/approval/output
features.acceptance: Quoted Windows/SSH scripts, explicit targets, revisions, approval/output/cancel and R1 SSH process-group lease cleanup implemented. Compile/run tests and validate live host cleanup and full manifest compatibility.

features.behavior: Application/Host/Audit/Problems views, search/filter/follow/export/open-folder
features.acceptance: R10 adds rotated-file merge, structured severity/source/case filters, independent host choice, counts, copy/open-folder and asynchronous bounded export/reads. Native disk/redaction/filter fixtures added; compiler/live checks remain R12.

features.behavior: release.json version/build, snapshot fingerprints, failure propagation, resumable steps
features.acceptance: Offline recipe checks normalize release versions, locks, fingerprints and failure/resume behavior. Compiler/package acceptance remains R12.

features.behavior: Single output root, portable folder/ZIP, separate installer, notices and offline runtimes
features.acceptance: Build kit packages Windows/Linux regression reports and matching catalog hashes, plus a required passing bundled-X11 result, with installer/ZIP runtimes. Offline artifact/failure fixtures pass; real packaging and clean-machine checks remain R12.

features.behavior: Original Windows native/Flutter/Python/Linux regressions become equivalent Rust checks
features.acceptance: R11 maps all 56 behavior groups and all 30 original UI suites to native regression checks and explicit live acceptance. Stage 2 requires compiled registrations and nonempty passing tests; Linux tests/helper fixtures and stage-4 bundled-X11 checks gate packages. No compiler/live check was run during this source work.

features.behavior: RDP/VNC, smart card/MFA/FIDO2 and sidebar placeholders must retain honest availability
features.acceptance: Original RDP/VNC entry points explicitly return not implemented; capability flags for smart card/MFA/FIDO2 false. Do not promote stubs to real support.

features.behavior: Stable log viewport, independent light/dark application palettes, sample GUI, theme import/export, application defaults, configurable navigation and public branding
features.acceptance: Compile the registered preference/theme/log fixtures and exercise apply/cancel, scrolling, persistence, native window scaling, startup and upgrade compatibility in packaged Windows builds.
